What can you find on Envato Elements?

The library brings together stock photos, video, graphics, fonts, music and templates. That can save time when a project needs several types of assets. For example, a small campaign may use a social post layout, a short video intro and a matching background track. Check each item before building your design around it. A preview can show extra files that are not part of the download.

Choose files that work with your software

A good-looking template is useful only if you can edit it. Read the item description for the required app, software version and any extra plugins. Check the file format, dimensions and included help files too. If you work in a team, agree on the tools you will use before downloading a whole set of assets.

Envato group buy access and project licensing

Compare the download allowance, access period and licensing process for this offer. Do not assume that shared access gives you a personal Envato subscription or covers every client project. Ask how the correct project license and proof of use will be provided. Envato Market purchases and separate AI tools can have different terms from the stock library.

  4. Keep the item details and license record with your project.

Frequently asked questions

Is Envato Elements the same as Envato Market?

No. They are different offers. Check where the item is listed and which terms apply to it.

Do not assume it does. The provider may apply a daily allowance or fair-use rules. Confirm this offer before ordering.

That depends on the applicable license and how it is issued for your project. Ask for the details and keep the record.

Do not assume AI generation is included with stock access. Check the exact features and any separate usage allowance.
